agencyName: NCSBN (National Council of State Boards of Nursing)
reliabilityRationale: The official site operated by NCSBN, the body that administers the Nurse Licensure Compact itself — the single most authoritative possible source for compact membership status. Not scored a full 1.0 only because compact 'enacted' vs. 'implemented' status can lag on any site (see Massachusetts, deliberately excluded from our member list for exactly this reason).
authorityRationale: nursecompact.com is the official site operated by NCSBN specifically to administer and publish Nurse Licensure Compact membership status — this is not a third party describing the compact, it IS the compact's own official record. Authoritative specifically for compactMembership facts; would not automatically extend authority to unrelated facts (e.g. a specific state's fee schedule) that this source does not itself govern or publish.
